name: Yuukyuu Kumikyoku All Star Project
original_name: 悠久組曲 All Star Project
source:
Yuukyuu Kumikyoku (Eternal Suite) is the final title in the Yuukyuu Gensoukyoku series, and is once again a traditional Japanese adventure game. The story takes place in an alternate continuity where the characters from the previous games are all students at the same school. The player chooses a character from the series history, and then must become friends with another character while also keeping on top of their studies.

[from [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/yky-kumikyoku-all-star-project]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
《悠久组曲》是《悠久幻想曲》系列的最后一部作品，同样是一款传统的日式冒险游戏。故事发生在另一条时间线中，前作中的人物都成了同一所学校的学生。玩家从系列历代角色中选择一人，在兼顾学业的同时，与另一名角色建立友谊。

[摘自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/yky-kumikyoku-all-star-project]MobyGames[/url]]
